from pathlib import Path


def replace_once(text, old, new, label):
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"{label}: expected exactly one match, found {count}")
    return text.replace(old, new, 1)


provenance_path = Path("golang/server/provenance_serving_test.go")
provenance = provenance_path.read_text()
provenance = replace_once(
    provenance,
    '''\t\ttargetServer := newServer(fakeStore{\n''',
    '''\t\ttargetServer := newServer(&domainAwareCallerStore{fakeStore: fakeStore{\n''',
    "domain-aware integration store",
)
provenance = replace_once(
    provenance,
    '''\t\t\tdescribeInbound: func(_ context.Context, iri string) ([]store.InboundTriple, error) {\n\t\t\t\tif iri != targetIRI {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf("caller lookup iri=%q, want %q", iri, targetIRI)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\treturn []store.InboundTriple{{Subject: mintedIRI(rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, callerID), Predicate: rdf.PropReferences}}, nil\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t})\n\t\tresp, err := targetServer.Briefing''',
    '''\t\t\tdescribeInbound: func(_ context.Context, iri string) ([]store.InboundTriple, error) {\n\t\t\t\tif iri != targetIRI {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf("caller lookup iri=%q, want %q", iri, targetIRI)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\treturn []store.InboundTriple{{Subject: mintedIRI(rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, callerID), Predicate: rdf.PropReferences}}, nil\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t}, domains: map[string][]string{\n\t\t\tmintedIRI(rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, callerID): {"globular"},\n\t\t}})\n\t\ttargetServer.homeDomain = "globular"\n\t\tresp, err := targetServer.Briefing''',
    "scoped caller fixture domains",
)
provenance_path.write_text(provenance)


reference_path = Path("golang/server/reference_sites_test.go")
reference = reference_path.read_text()
reference = replace_once(
    reference,
    '''\t\tfocused := focusCodeSymbolsForTask("change Render behavior", syms)\n\t\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(focused, syms) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf("ambiguous simple name must preserve all symbols: got %+v", focused)\n\t\t}\n''',
    '''\t\tfocused := focusCodeSymbolsForTask("change Render behavior", syms)\n\t\tif len(focused) != 2 || focused[0].targeted || focused[1].targeted {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf("ambiguous simple name must preserve two unfocused symbols: got %+v", focused)\n\t\t}\n''',
    "ambiguity assertion ignores internal lookup aliases",
)
reference_path.write_text(reference)
